command_line:
set -eu
export INPUT_FILE="/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78565479/inputs/dataset_d64fbfc4-2b3c-4a71-be02-6151f5fcb6be.dat"

cat > run_deseq2.R << 'REOF'
library(DESeq2)

counts <- read.csv(Sys.getenv("INPUT_FILE"), row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)

samples <- colnames(counts)
condition <- ifelse(grepl("^KL", samples), "KL", "WL")
coldata <- data.frame(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("KL", "WL")), row.names = samples)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "WL", "KL"))
res_shrunken <- lfcShrink(dds, contrast = c("condition", "WL", "KL"), type = "normal")

res_df <- data.frame(
  geneID = rownames(res_shrunken),
  baseMean = res_shrunken$baseMean,
  log2FoldChange = res_shrunken$log2FoldChange,
  lfcSE = res_shrunken$lfcSE,
  pvalue = res_shrunken$pvalue,
  padj = res_shrunken$padj,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

sig <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$pvalue) & !is.na(res_df$baseMean) & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange), ]
sig <- sig[sig$baseMean > 10 & sig$pvalue < 0.05 & abs(sig$log2FoldChange) > 1, ]

write.table(sig, file = "filtered_results.tabular", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
writeLines(sig$geneID, con = "significant_gene_ids.txt")

cat(sprintf("Total genes: %d, Significant DEGs: %d\n", nrow(res_df), nrow(sig)))
REOF

Rscript run_deseq2.R
